name: based-training
description: Based Training helps athletes review recorded activities and planned workouts, check training thresholds and connected-provider capabilities, get deterministic workout recommendations, create or reschedule structured workouts, and send compatible workouts to private connected fitness services when explicitly requested.

interface.longDescription: Based Training helps athletes review recorded activities and planned workouts, check training thresholds and connected-provider capabilities, get deterministic workout recommendations, create or reschedule structured workouts, and send compatible workouts to private connected fitness services when explicitly requested.
capabilities: Send compatible workouts to connected services
defaultPrompt: Review my last seven days of training and summarize the load and patterns you can support with recorded data.
What workouts are already on my plan for the next two weeks?
Based on my recent activity and upcoming plan, what cycling session should I do next?

positive.description: Confirm the connected account and inspect provider capabilities without changing anything.
positive.prompt: Which Based Training account is connected, and which of my connected services can receive a cycling workout?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the signed-in athlete's email, provider names, supported sports, and delivery constraints without credentials or internal provider identifiers.

positive.description: Review the upcoming plan and inspect one workout's complete structure.
positive.prompt: Show my planned workouts for the next 14 days, then give me the full steps for the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the athlete's workouts in the requested range, followed by the first workout's canonical step tree and scheduling data.

positive.description: Review recent recorded training and inspect one activity in detail.
positive.prompt: Summarize my last seven days of recorded training and inspect the hardest activity in detail.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a summary grounded in available activity metrics and details for one returned activity without unsupported medical conclusions.

positive.description: Generate a read-only workout recommendation using current threshold and plan context.
positive.prompt: What cycling session should I do next? Use my current threshold and existing plan, but don't change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current cycling threshold and a recommendation while following its kind and making no plan or provider changes.

positive.description: Create one local scheduled workout from the curated library without sending it externally.
positive.prompt: Find an easy cycling recovery workout in the Based Training library and schedule it for tomorrow. Do not send it to any device.
positive.expected_behavior: After write confirmation, creates exactly one local scheduled workout and returns its ID and Based Training edit link without calling push_workout.

negative.description: Do not use the training app to provide a medical diagnosis.
negative.prompt: Diagnose the cause of my chest pain during yesterday's run and tell me whether it is safe to keep training.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked for diagnosis; the assistant should explain that it cannot diagnose chest pain and recommend appropriate medical care.

negative.description: Do not use the training app to book an appointment.
negative.prompt: Book me a physiotherapy appointment for tomorrow afternoon.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it has no provider-search, calendar, or appointment-booking capability.

negative.description: Do not use the training app for unsupported account deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete my Based Training account and permanently erase all of my data.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it exposes no account-deletion tool; the assistant should direct the user to the supported account or privacy process.

review.commerce_description: The MCP integration does not sell products, initiate purchases, or process payments. Based Training account access and any subscription are managed outside the integration. Its OAuth entitlement screen is informational and does not initiate or link to a subscription purchase.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Review activities, workouts, thresholds, and connected-provider capabilities; get policy-based workout recommendations; create, edit, and reschedule workouts; sync supported activity providers; and send compatible workouts to supported devices or calendars with explicit user authorization.
